_comment: Cross-language parity fixture for giant placement v2 (GiantGenerator.PlaceCore backend / placeGiants frontend): given a synthetic island's tiles (with terrain), rivers, a world seed and an island index, both sides must place the same giants in the same order. Covers: an island below the size threshold (no giants), a single qualifying mountain cluster, two mountain clusters on a large island plus a shrine roll that finds a non-coastal clearing, a mountain cluster disqualified by a river cutting through its footprint, and a shrine roll that fires but finds no non-coastal spot on a thin island. GiantPlacementGoldenTests.cs (backend) and giantPlacement.golden.test.ts (frontend) each compute against this fixture using their own production placement implementation, then assert the frozen `giants` list below (order matters: it is the deterministic placement order, not sorted for comparison).
